index.title: Drivers
index.subtitle: Who can legally move a load, and whose paperwork is about to lapse.
index.emptyHint: Add the first driver. A load cannot be dispatched without one.
index.noResultsHint: Clear the filters to see everything you have access to.
index.searchPlaceholder: Name, email, phone or last four of the licence

scope.assigned: Drivers of the carriers in your book

detail.licenceHidden: Stored encrypted. Only the last four are ever shown.
detail.noCarriers: Not linked to any carrier. A driver must drive for a carrier to be assigned a load.

verify.title: Review the licence
verify.hint: Say what you found after checking the licence against the document itself.
verify.notesRequired: Anything other than «verified» stops this driver being assigned a load. Write down why.

form.createSubtitle: A driver is added unverified. Reviewing the licence is a separate act.
form.licenceHint: Stored encrypted. Only the last four are shown afterwards, and it can never be read back.
form.licenceKeep: Leave blank to keep the number already on file.
form.licenceTaken: That licence number is already on file for {name}.
form.endorsementsHint: H hazmat · N tank · T doubles/triples · P passenger · X hazmat+tank
form.carriersHint: The first one is the primary carrier. A driver can only be assigned loads of a carrier listed here.
form.noCarriers: No approved carriers yet. Add a carrier first.
form.qualificationHint: Nothing here is checked automatically. Someone looks at the document and records what they saw — the save stamps who and when. Loads carry the requirements; this side carries the facts.
form.twicLast4Hint: Only the last four are stored, same as the licence.
form.workAuthorizationHint: Optional, and it stays optional. Only some loads require it, and only when a contract says so in writing.
form.recordCleanYearsHint: How far back the record came back clean. Blank is «not checked»; 0 is «checked, and there is something within the last year».
form.recordNotesHint: What was checked and where. Do not paste the full history here.
